slides.title: ATAK asks you to sign in
slides.html: The first time ATAK connects to your OpenDefence TAK server, it asks you to sign in to the chat. Tap OpenDefence Matrix in your notifications.

slides.title: Tap Sign in
slides.html: Tap Sign in. The chat bubble in ATAK's toolbar also opens this page.

slides.title: Choose your certificate
slides.html: Pick the certificate with your callsign if the browser asks, and tap SELECT. On the next pages tap Continue, and Create Account the first time.

slides.title: Verify this phone
slides.html: Back in Chats, tap Verify, then Use my recovery key, enter the key and tap Unlock. On your first phone the yellow line offers Set up instead, so save the key it gives you.
